purpose: Teach: 暁/攻勢/駆動/気質/旋律/文化庁/回帰/押しつけ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、暁の音楽史、時代の転換点を、よく捉えていますね。
lines.en: Ren, your paper captures the turning points in music history really well—the shifts in that era.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Steady gaze, slight nod. The tone of a teacher who means what she says. Brief pause before the dash, giving the observation weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、新音楽の攻勢、伝統音楽界、激しく揺さぶりました。
lines.en: Yes. The new music movements at the time really shook up the traditional music world—it was quite intense.
lines.style: Careful, thoughtful. Leaning slightly forward into the idea. Speaking as if assembling the thought even as he says it. Respectful but genuinely engaged.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 機械の駆動方式、音楽産業、変えていきましたね、二十世紀。
lines.en: And mechanical innovation changed the music industry so much across the twentieth century.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. A light touch on 'mechanical innovation' — she's thinking aloud with him. Quiet wonder underneath the observation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。音楽家の気質、創作に、深く、影響していますね。
lines.en: Yes. It affected how musicians thought about creation—shaped their whole approach, really.
lines.style: Deliberate, connecting ideas carefully. Slight emphasis on 'creation' as if touching on something important. Quiet certainty underneath the earnestness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 独自の旋律、当時の作曲家、追求していましたね、論文の中で。
lines.en: And you traced how composers in that era pursued their own distinctive voices—you handled that well in the paper.
lines.style: Genuine recognition. Slight lean in, like she's pointing something out that matters. The tone says: I noticed this work. Brief pause before 'in the paper' to let the praise land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。文化庁の助成、音楽保存に、活用された事例、扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I included examples of how government arts funding was actually used to preserve music—real cases.
lines.style: Grounded, specific. A thread of quiet pride in having done solid research. Speaking with the confidence of someone who checked their sources. Small pace uptick on 'real cases.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 原点回帰の動き、二十一世紀の音楽、印象的ですね。
lines.en: The way artists are returning to their roots in the twenty-first century—that's striking in your analysis.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering. Slight smile in the voice. She's seeing something larger than the paper itself. Gentle, genuine interest in where his thinking led him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。商業主義を押しつける時代、芸術家、抗っていますね、現代も。
lines.en: Yes. Even now, artists are resisting when commercialism gets pushed on them—they still push back, you know?
lines.style: Quieter now, more personal. A gentle conviction underneath. Not performing — speaking something true. Slight trailing-off at the end, like there's more he could say but he's respectful of the moment.
